name: Queen-Regent Martinique
source:
Queen-Regent Martinique is your only living parent, and while it is difficult for her to step away from you, she knows you have your own destiny to forge.

There are whispers among the nobility that while she's beloved by the common people, she is an ineffectual leader at best... Your coronation cannot come soon enough as far as she's concerned.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/490618601/queens-crown]Kickstarter[/url]]
